messages:
Olivia: follow-up from the Dedicated GPU pools RFC: we need a compact operator<->control-plane microcontract for scaling intents. today warmup, burst credits and eviction overlap and cause customer-visible cold starts.
Sam: saw a tenant drop out during soft prewarm yesterday, ~120s cold-start. we need clearer failure semantics.
Ria: propose timeboxed idempotent intent: control-plane POSTs intent blob; operator must ACK accept/reject within N ms. no ACK => control-plane follows fallback.
Ben: sketch fields: intent {target_slots, min_slots, prewarm:soft|hard, deadline_ms, fallback, version}. reply {accepted, provision_id, allocated_slots, est_warmup_ms, burst_budget, ttl_ms}.
Arjun: add probe/heartbeat: if operator ACKs but never materializes, control-plane detects via probe + ttl expiry and reissues intent.
Maya: for UX, make fallback options: spill_to_burst_lane, queue_with_timeout, immediate_deny. default = spill for latency-sensitive tiers.
Sam: burst lane must be rate-limited + circuit-protected to avoid noisy neighbors. control-plane should enforce burst caps per-shard.
Ria: require operator to report burst_budget and est_warmup so control-plane can gate admission. also emit metrics intent_ack_latency_ms and provision_outcome.
Ben: sample JSON: ```intent:{"target_slots":4,"min_slots":2,"prewarm":"soft","deadline_ms":20000,"fallback":"spill_to_burst_lane","version":"v1"} reply:{"accepted":true,"provision_id":"prv-001","allocated_slots":4,"est_warmup_ms":12000,"burst_budget":45,"ttl_ms":120000}```
Arjun: add provision_ttl_ms so control-plane can garbage-collect stalled provisions. infra-bot: created ticket INF-2077 to add a lightweight /probe endpoint.
Maya: add an audit trace id to each intent for SRE postmortems. tiny 64b id is enough.
Olivia: failure flow: on mid-warm failure mark provision failed, consult fallback, optionally reissue to another operator shard with backoff. control-plane must avoid hot retry loops.
Sam: what about partial fulfills? operator must error if allocated_slots < min_slots. control-plane treats such a reply as a rejection.
Ria: tests: add a sim that ACKs then kills operator to validate fallback and metrics. I'll add it to autoscale test-suite.
Ben: implementation note: keep blobs opaque & versioned; reject unknown major versions.
Olivia: actions: Ben -> draft microcontract doc; Arjun+infra -> probe + metrics; Sam+Ria -> ttl enforcement + fallback routing; Ria -> sim test. I'll open a PR by EOD unless objections. :thumbsup:
Maya: no objections.
infra-bot: INF-2077 created: add /probe and intent metrics emitters.
Ben: will include example timelines and sample CI sim steps in the draft.
Olivia: thanks all, making this explicit will reduce surprise evictions and make debugging simpler.
